g1-collect.title: Dry-run + OS-detached collection launch (Austria R8 + Great Britain R9)
g1-collect.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew dispatch. Waiver reason: this gate's deliverable is an operational side effect (running the already-shipped, unmodified collector against the canonical DB), not a reviewable code diff; the Commander runs it directly in this context per commander-core.md 'Crew gate vs reasoning gate'. Steps: (1) run `py scripts/collect_evo_data.py --seasons 2026 --dry-run` to confirm the exact FastF1 GP-name strings for Austria and Great Britain and the GB session set (expect FP1, Sprint Qualifying, Sprint, Qualifying, Race per the launch order's stated likely set — verify, don't assume); (2) rewrite .agent-work/cmdr-603/STATE_NOTE.md (step, slug, next command, PID placeholder, expected artifact) from the STATE_NOTE template BEFORE launching; (3) launch collection OS-detached via PowerShell Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath py -ArgumentList (collect_evo_data.py --seasons 2026 --gp <Austria-name> --gp <GB-name> --sessions <verified list incl. sprint types> --report-json .agent-work/cmdr-603/collect-report.json), WITHOUT --include-telemetry and WITHOUT --rounds; (4) immediately rewrite STATE_NOTE.md again with the real PID; (5) poll the report-json / DB in a loop inside this turn (never end the turn to 'wait') until the collector process exits or the report shows completion, honoring the 55s inter-session delay and 20-min rate-limit wait as expected latency, not a stall.

postconditions.statement: dry-run run and exact GP-name strings + GB session set confirmed
postconditions.satisfied_by: Dry-run superseded (script requires --worklist for --dry-run now); session sets confirmed instead via get_weekend_sessions(2026,'Austria')=[FP1,FP2,FP3,Q,R], get_weekend_sessions(2026,'Great Britain')=[FP1,SQ,S,Q,R] (matches launch-order's likely-set guess exactly).

g2-verify-report.title: Verify collected data + write report
g2-verify-report.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew dispatch (same waiver as g1: verification queries + a report document, not a reviewable code diff). Steps: (1) for every session type collected for R8 and R9, call has_session_classification(2026, 8|9, <type>) and get_session_classification / get_session_driver_info via a small py -c script against src/data/database.py's DatabaseManager, confirm FP positions are populated (not null, derived from best lap) and confirm round mapping (Austria=8, GB=9, not shifted by the Bahrain/Saudi 2026 drop); (2) spot-check R8 and R9 race (and sprint, if collected) winner/podium against known 2026 results; (3) note whether the Parquet mirror needs action (classifications/laps-only vs telemetry-only mirror) rather than guessing; (4) write .agent-work/cmdr-603/cmdr-603-report.md per the launch order's Return Shape (verdict, per-session-type table, round-mapping confirmation, spot-check results, detached PID + report-json path, Parquet-mirror note, worktree-isolation exemption note, triage candidates, workflow feedback, lessons-delta proposal).

triage_candidates.statement: collect_evo_data.py --dry-run now requires --worklist (raises ValueError standalone); the launch-order template's bare --dry-run example is stale as of this run.

collect_evo_data.py --gp is single-value only (argparse type=str); a launch order asking to restrict two GPs in one call (--gp A --gp B) silently takes only the last value. Worth a --help/doc note so future launch orders assume two sequential invocations, not one multi-gp call.
